core: Stress-axis glucocorticoid secretion and innate social behaviors
qualifier: corticotropin-driven glucocorticoid secretion
name: Stress-axis glucocorticoid secretion and innate social behaviors
rationale: Members combine HPA-axis corticotropin/glucocorticoid secretion and stress responses with mating, parental, aggressive and drinking behaviors; the glucocorticoid secretion arm separates it from the neuropeptide/sleep and feeding neighbours.

qualifier: Leloir galactose and glucuronate-xylulose route
name: Leloir galactose and glucuronate-xylulose pentose metabolism
rationale: Members cover Leloir galactose catabolism and its defects plus glucuronate-to-xylulose pentose metabolism and pentose-phosphate enzyme defects, lacking the fructose/glycerol content of neighbours and the shunt core of C3.

qualifier: E-cadherin and cadherin-11 turnover, trafficking and signaling
name: E-cadherin and cadherin-11 protein turnover and signaling
rationale: Members concern CDH1 degradation, processing, trafficking and pathogen use, and CDH11 interactions and STAT3 signaling, at protein level rather than the junction assembly or transcriptional control of the confusables.

qualifier: two-pore-domain potassium channels
name: Two-pore-domain potassium channels in pain and thermosensation
rationale: Members are K2P channel families (TASK, TWIK, TREK, TRESK, THIK) with resting potential and pain/temperature detection, distinct from TRP/itch, sour-taste TALK and Ca-activated K+ neighbours.

qualifier: PPARG-regulated white, brown and beige lineages
name: PPARG-regulated white, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation
rationale: All members concern adipocyte differentiation, proliferation and adipose development with PPARG control, lacking the PGC-1alpha/mitochondrial, LXR lipid and thermogenesis content of confusables.

qualifier: GTPase activity regulation
name: Regulation of nuclear protein import/export and GTPase activity
rationale: Most members regulate nuclear protein import and export or GTPase activity (two growth-control BTM modules are peripheral), differing from the nuclear pore/RNA export, viral and senescence neighbours.

qualifier: respiratory complex assembly with heme and iron-sulfur cofactor synthesis
name: Respiratory chain assembly with heme and iron-sulfur cofactor synthesis
rationale: Members are electron transport, complex I-IV and ATP synthase assembly plus heme, Fe-S cluster and ubiquinol biosynthesis, lacking the mitochondrial import, TCA and mitochondrial translation content of confusables.

qualifier: CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition
name: CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition of TCR signaling
rationale: Members cover CD3/ZAP-70 proximal TCR events, CD28 costimulatory branches and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition, unlike downstream TCR/IL-2 or B cell receptor neighbours.

qualifier: betaglycan co-receptor and TGFBR1 cancer mutants
name: Betaglycan and TGFBR1 receptor-level TGF-beta superfamily signaling
rationale: Members concern TGFBR3 regulation of TGF-beta/activin/FGF2, activin and AMH receptor signaling and TGFBR1/SMAD2/3 motif mutants, rather than SMAD transcription or TGFBR2/SMAD4 mutants in confusables.

qualifier: YAP/TAZ mechanoresponsive programme and proliferation
name: YAP/TAZ-driven stromal fibroblast activation and proliferation
rationale: Members describe mechanoresponsive fibroblast/stromal programmes, focal adhesion and fibroblast proliferation, without the EMT, fibronectin matrix and migration content of the confusables.

qualifier: TRAF3/TRAF6 effector arm to IRF and NF-kB
name: RIG-I-like receptor signaling through TRAF3/TRAF6 to IRF and NF-kB
rationale: Members are RLR antiviral signaling and its TRAF3/TRAF6/FADD outputs to IRF and NF-kB, versus confusables centred on RIG-I/MDA5 regulation and dsRNA sensing.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism
name: Purine nucleotide de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: Members span de novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis, PRPP, purine salvage and its enzyme defects and catabolism to allantoin, lacking the pyrimidine and NUDT/thiopurine content of confusables.

qualifier: receptor tyrosine phosphatases and SALMs
name: Receptor phosphatase and SALM trans-synaptic adhesion in synapse assembly
rationale: Members are synaptic adhesion and pre/post-synapse assembly regulation with receptor-type PTPs and SALMs, rather than the neurexin-neuroligin and receptor clustering content of confusables.

qualifier: Fas/TRAIL caspase-8 in T cell immunity
name: Fas and TRAIL death-receptor apoptosis in T cell immunity
rationale: Members cover Fas/TRAIL, caspase-8, c-FLIP and BID signaling with T cell death, allograft and tumor-cell killing, lacking the necroptosis and mitochondrial apoptosis of confusables.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor-driven recruitment and degranulation
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil recruitment and degranulation
rationale: Members are neutrophil recruitment, degranulation, complement-receptor and formyl peptide receptor responses, unlike chemotaxis-regulation or monocyte/inflammatory neighbours.

qualifier: AP-site processing, gap filling and OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1 defects
name: Base excision repair gap filling and OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1 defects
rationale: Members cover APEX1 displacement, short- and long-patch gap filling and OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1 defects, lacking the damaged-base recognition/cleavage and NEIL content of confusables.

qualifier: COPII cargo export and COPI retrograde coats
name: COPII cargo export and COPI retrograde ER-Golgi vesicle traffic
rationale: Members concern COPII cargo loading and budding and COPI Golgi-to-ER retrieval, rather than vesicle tethering/targeting or ER translocation and quality control in confusables.

qualifier: TNF receptor superfamily, canonical and non-canonical
name: TNF receptor superfamily canonical and non-canonical NF-kB activation
rationale: Members are TNFR1, CD40 and TNFSF-driven canonical and NIK non-canonical NF-kB activation with linear ubiquitination, versus TCR, TLR/RIP1 or negative-regulation NF-kB neighbours.

qualifier: activation and regulation across all pathways
name: Complement cascade activation and regulation
rationale: All members are classical, lectin, alternative and terminal complement activation and its regulation; confusables share none and are hypersensitivity, antimicrobial or myeloid themes.

qualifier: podocyte, mesangium and basement membrane filtration barrier
name: Glomerular filtration barrier development: podocyte, mesangium, basement membrane
rationale: Members concern glomerular podocyte, mesangial, endothelial and basement membrane development and filtration, lacking the tubule development and brush border/polarity content of confusables.

qualifier: GTPase cycles and effector activation
name: Rho-family GTPase cycles and effector activation
rationale: Members are RHO/RAC/CDC42/RND GTPase cycles, upstream G12/13 and Sema4D input and effectors (ROCK, formins, PAK, WASP/WAVE), rather than the downstream actin filament operations of confusables.

qualifier: cGAS-STING/GBP sensing with CCL5 and dendritic cell cytokines
name: Dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 production in cGAS-STING/GBP defense
rationale: Members link cGAS-STING, GBP and inflammasome defense against intracellular pathogens to CCL5 and dendritic cell cytokine production, without the Th1, interferon antiviral or other chemokine content of confusables.

qualifier: integrin activation and heterotypic docking
name: Integrin-activated leukocyte heterotypic adhesion and docking
rationale: Members concern leukocyte cell-cell adhesion via integrin activation, PECAM1 and membrane docking, lacking immunological synapse formation and Rap1/MAPK integrin signaling of confusables.

qualifier: balance in epidermal wound repair
name: Keratinocyte proliferation-differentiation balance in epidermal wound repair
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis and epidermal wound spreading, without the cornification, melanocyte/hair or wound-migration content of confusables.

qualifier: defensins and microbial membrane disruption
name: Defensin antimicrobial peptide production and microbial membrane disruption
rationale: Members are alpha/beta defensins and antimicrobial peptide production and action, lacking the antifungal, metal sequestration, intestinal and mucosal content of confusables.
